business_summary.text: Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited manufactures solar modules and TOPCon cells, with integrated manufacturing facilities and a growing order book.

call_points.text: The 6 GW integrated cell and module project capex of ₹5,500 Cr includes ₹4,600 Cr in hard costs.
Order book stands at 10.4 gigawatts, with 1.5 gigawatts of new inflows secured during Q2 FY27.
EBITDA margins were maintained at approximately 35% through operational efficiencies and reduced silver consumption.
Net debt to equity ratio stood at approximately 0.12x as of September 30, 2026.
Project cost about ₹5,500 Cr with ₹4,600 Cr hard costs and ₹3,300 Cr debt; most hard-cost orders already placed.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated the ₹5,500 Cr cost and ₹3,300 Cr debt from the July call

call_points.text: Gross margin fell to 42% in Q2FY27 from 47% a year ago as material costs rose faster than revenue.
Targets approximately ₹2,400 Cr EBITDA by close of FY27.
Total project cost ₹5,500 Cr, including ₹4,600 Cr hard costs; ₹3,300 Cr debt tied up below 8%.
Post-expansion capacity to reach 16.3 GW modules and 8.9 GW cells by end-FY27.
EBITDA per watt: module ₹2.5, cell ₹6.0-6.5, DCR module ₹8.5-9.
DCR mix was over 50% in Q1, supporting margins; mix may shift to more non-DCR in coming quarters.
Finance costs fell to ₹11.1 Cr from ₹53.1 Cr a year ago, aiding PAT growth.
Silver import restrictions: management says no difficulty, applying three months ahead to DGFT.
DCR module pricing at ₹21-22/watt vs non-DCR at ₹14-15/watt
Working capital cycle expected to normalize as major expansions conclude
Exports treated as upside; currently zero exports in FY26
Two ICRA upgrades in FY26 took the rating to A (FB) / A2+ (NFB).
DCR schemes (CPSU, PM-KUSUM, PM Surya Ghar) offer at least 40 GW of order opportunity for Indian makers.
ALMM for cells is proposed from 1 June 2026 and wafers from 1 June 2028, raising domestic sourcing requirements.

operating_notes.text: IPO raised ₹2,900 Cr in total, of which ₹2,143.86 Cr was the fresh issue; shares listed on BSE and NSE from November 18, 2025.
Of the ₹2,060 Cr net IPO proceeds, ₹1,621.29 Cr was used to repay borrowings and ₹347.05 Cr for general corporate purposes, leaving ₹91.66 Cr unutilised at March 31, 2026.
The company allotted 53,95,90,500 bonus shares in the ratio of 10 for every 1 held, per the EGM resolution of April 18, 2025.
FY26 module capacity utilisation was 54% and cell utilisation 79% in Q4FY26.
Order book rose from 4.9 GW to 9.4 GW in FY26, including a 4.5 GW cell order executed December 2025 to 2030.
FY26 operating cash flow was ₹200 Cr against PAT of ₹1,082 Cr as receivables and inventories absorbed ₹1,484 Cr.
FY26 module production doubled to 2,999 MW; cell production grew 3x to 1,520 MW.
Net debt to equity stood at negative 0.06x as of March 31, 2026.
Module capacity utilization for FY26 was 43%, impacted by new units commissioned mid-year.
IPO proceeds utilisation reached ₹2,044.93 Cr out of ₹2,143.86 Cr as of March 31, 2026.
Q1FY27 module production 970 MW, cell production 454 MW; module utilisation 45%, cell utilisation 83%.
Order book 9.9 GW at end-Q1FY27; Q1 inflow 1,484 MW; about 7 GW to be executed over next 18 months.
EBITDA per watt guidance: module ₹2.5, cell ₹6.0-6.5, DCR module ₹8.5-9.
Q2FY27 effective capacity utilisation was 89% for solar cells and 44% for modules.
Installed capacity at 30 September 2026 was about 10.3 GW modules and 2.94 GW TOPCon cells.
H1FY27 net cash from operating activities was ₹409.9 Cr versus ₹120.7 Cr in H1FY26.
Installed capacity at 30 September 2026 was 10,308 MW modules and 2,943 MW TOPCon cells.
Order book at Q2FY27 was 10,404 MW, with 1.5 GW of new inflow in the quarter.
Cell production reached 513 megawatts with 89% capacity utilization in Q2 FY27.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,738.81 Cr, net profit ₹392.38 Cr.
2026-04-28: Q4 & FY26 investor presentation — FY26 revenue ₹5,050 Cr (+116%), PAT ₹1,082 Cr (+193%), order book 9.4 GW; IREDA sanctions ₹3,306 Cr for 6 GW expansion.
Emmvee Photovoltaic reported FY26 revenue growth of 116% to ₹5,049 Cr and PAT growth of 193% to ₹1,082 Cr, while securing a ₹3,306 Cr loan for its 6 GW integrated expansion.
Emmvee Photovoltaic Power filed its Monitoring Agency Report for Q4 FY26 showing ₹2,045 Cr of IPO proceeds utilised.
2026-07-16: Q1FY27 earnings call reported revenue ₹1,555 Cr (+51% YoY), EBITDA ₹548.1 Cr, PAT ₹380.3 Cr; order book 9.9 GW.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,576.38 Cr (+39.4% YoY), net profit ₹382.05 Cr (+60.6% YoY).
2026-10-14: Q2FY27 investor presentation showed revenue ₹1,576 Cr (+39% YoY), EBITDA ₹557 Cr, PAT ₹382 Cr (+61% YoY), order book 10.4 GW and 89% cell utilisation.
Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q2FY27 earnings conference call on its website on October 15, 2026.
Emmvee Photovoltaic Power reported H1 FY27 revenue of ₹3,132 Cr with a 10.4 GW order book and maintained its expansion timeline for the 6 GW facility.
